summary: Spok Holdings filed an 8-K to report Q1 2026 financial results and declare a regular quarterly dividend of $0.3125 per share, payable June 24, 2026 to holders of record May 26, 2026. The filing also notes a strategic realignment with expected annual cost savings over $6 million and a 10% workforce reduction. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, or deal termination is involved. The dividend is a routine, recurring capital return, not a special capital return event. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement.
